resources.string: Choose who sees your details and who can add you to groups. People you have blocked never see any of this.
Who can add me to groups
People will need an invite link to add you to a group.
Let people find me by my phone number
When this is on, someone who has your phone number can find your Samvad account. When it is off, your account is never shown as a match, even to people who have your number saved.
\"People I chat with\" means people you share a direct chat with: you started the chat, or you have sent them a message. Samvad does not read or store your phone\'s contacts on its servers.

These are the installs signed in to your account. Signing out a device here does not happen instantly: that phone signs itself out the next time it opens the app or receives the signal, which needs it to be online.
No other devices are signed in.
This device will be signed out once it is next online, either right away or the next time it opens the app. It will need to sign in again to use Samvad.
Couldn\'t sign out that device. Check your connection and try again.
If you think a report decision or account restriction was a mistake, tell us what happened. We read every appeal.
You\'ve sent several appeals today. Try again tomorrow.
Couldn\'t send the appeal. Check your connection and try again.

Your phone number is visible only to you. One-to-one chats can be end-to-end encrypted, and each chat tells you if it is. Groups, older chats and calls are not end-to-end encrypted; they are protected in transit and at rest by Firebase.
